operations.title: Every four-cycle OFPT term has filtered infinity incidence
operations.body: Entry 1160 (event 907): every one of the 28 C4 terms has complementary source labels with identical infinity normal. Profiles are 20×(2,1,1,1,1,1) and 8×(2,2,1,1,1). Of 196 marked residue pivots, 72 pivot on a duplicated normal class, so the partner survives only at the next affine/compactification order; 188 pivots also have 1 or 2 forced triple concurrencies. Thus the higher-site object is not a generic SNC union of independent elliptic curves: it requires occurrence-resolved filtered infinity specialization, still over existing marked-hyperplane support.

authority_basis.summary: Share Entry 1160 forced-incidence result with Nima.
